blurb: Guests can experience guided tastings of Blue Grouse wines paired with Italian-inspired bites, explore the vineyard and cellar with a tour including a locally curated lunch, and attend special events such as the Harvest Party and Dim Sum Pop-up. Group tastings are available for parties of six or more with curated experiences. The winery is located in the Cowichan Valley on Vancouver Island, BC.
